lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੇਵ ॥੨॥੫॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daas saranaagatee har purakh pooran dev ||2||5||8||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord, the Perfect, Divine Primal Being. ||2||5||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh meraa a(n)tarajaamee jaan ||
lines.translation: My God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of Hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa pooran paramesar nihachal sach sabad neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Take pity on me, O Perfect Transcendent Lord; bless me with the True Eternal Insignia of the Shabad, the Word of God. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਨ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਸ ਤੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bin aan na koee samarath teree aas teraa man taan ||
lines.translation: O Lord, other than You, no one is all-powerful. You are the Hope and the Strength of my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਪਹਿਰਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sarab ghataa ke daate suaamee dehi s pahiran khaan ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Giver to the hearts of all beings, O Lord and Master. I eat and wear whatever You give me. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: surat mat chaturaaee sobhaa roop ra(n)g dhan maan ||
lines.translation: Intuitive understanding, wisdom and cleverness, glory and beauty, pleasure, wealth and honor,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਲਿਆਣੁ ॥੨॥੬॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: sarab sookh aana(n)d naanak jap raam naam kaliaan ||2||6||9||
lines.translation: all comforts, bliss, happiness and salvation, O Nanak, come by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||6||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਕਲਿਆਨ ਕਰਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: har charan saran kaliaan karan ||
lines.translation: The Sanctuary of the Lord's Feet bring salvation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh naam patit paavano ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: God's Name is the Purifier of sinners. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਪਿ ਨਿਸੰਗ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨ ਖਾਵਨੋ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g jap nisa(n)g jamakaal tis na khaavano ||1||
lines.translation: Whoever chants and meditates in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, shall undoubtedly escape being consumed by the Messenger of Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਸੂਖ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: mukat jugat anik sookh har bhagat lavai na laavano ||
lines.translation: Liberation, the key to success, and all sorts of comforts do not equal loving devotional worship of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਰਸ ਲੁਬਧ ਦਾਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਨੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: prabh daras lubadh daas naanak bahuR jon na dhaavano ||2||7||10||
lines.translation: Slave Nanak longs for the Blessed Vision of God's Darshan; he shall never again wander in reincarnation. ||2||||7||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਆਨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaliaan mahalaa 4 asatapadeeaa ||
lines.translation: Kalyaan, Fourth Mehl, Ashtpadheeyaa:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਾ ਰਮ ਰਾਮੋ ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamaa ram raamo sun man bheejai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name of the Lord, the All-pervading Lord, my mind is drenched with joy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam a(n)mrit ras meethaa guramat sahaje peejai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is Ambrosial Nectar, the most Sweet and Sublime Essence; through the Guru's Teachings, drink it in with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਸਟ ਮਹਿ ਜਿਉ ਹੈ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਮਥਿ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਕਢੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaasat mahi jiu hai baisa(n)tar math sa(n)jam kaadh kadheejai ||
lines.translation: The potential energy of fire is within the wood; it is released if you know how to rub it and generate friction.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਬਾਈ ਤਤੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਈਜੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: raam naam hai jot sabaaee tat guramat kaadh laeejai ||1||
lines.translation: In just the same way, the Lord's Name is the Light within all; the Essence is extracted by following the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਦਰਵਾਜ ਨਵੇ ਦਰ ਫੀਕੇ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦਸਵੇ ਚੁਈਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau daravaaj nave dar pheeke ras a(n)mrit dasave chueejai ||
lines.translation: There are nine doors, but the taste of these nine doors is bland and insipid. The Essence of Ambrosial Nectar trickles down through the Tenth Door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kirapaa kar piaare gurasabadee har ras peejai ||2||
lines.translation: Please take pity on me - be kind and compassionate, O my Beloved, that I may drink in the Sublime Essence of the Lord, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰੁ ਨਗਰੁ ਹੈ ਨੀਕੋ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਉਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa nagar nagar hai neeko vich saudaa har ras keejai ||
lines.translation: The body-village is the most sublime and exalted village, in which the merchandise of the Lord's Sublime Essence is traded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਅਮੋਲ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ratan laal amol amolak satigur sevaa leejai ||3||
lines.translation: The most precious and priceless gems and jewels are obtained by serving the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਹੈ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਰਿ ਸਾਗਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur agam agam hai thaakur bhar saagar bhagat kareejai ||
lines.translation: The True Guru is Inaccessible; Inaccessible is our Lord and Master. He is the overflowing Ocean of bliss - worship Him with loving devotion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਹਮ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਇਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: kripaa kripaa kar deen ham saari(n)g ik boo(n)d naam mukh deejai ||4||
lines.translation: Please take pity on me, and be Merciful to this meek song-bird; please pour a drop of Your Name into my mouth. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਨੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਹੈ ਰੰਗਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰੰਗਨ ਕਉ ਗੁਰ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalan laal laal hai ra(n)gan man ra(n)gan kau gur deejai ||
lines.translation: O Beloved Lord, please color my mind with the Deep Crimson Color of Your Love; I have surrendered my mind to the Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਸ ਰਸਿਕ ਗਟਕ ਨਿਤ ਪੀਜੈ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: raam raam raam ra(n)g raate ras rasik gatak nit peejai ||5||
lines.translation: Those who are imbued with the Love of the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam, continually drink in this essence in big gulps, savoring its sweet taste. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਸਪਤ ਦੀਪ ਹੈ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਢਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਕਾਢਿ ਧਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: basudhaa sapat deep hai saagar kadh ka(n)chan kaadh dhareejai ||
lines.translation: If all the gold of the seven continents and the oceans was taken out and placed before them,

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਇਨਹੁ ਨ ਬਾਛਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: mere thaakur ke jan inahu na baachhahi har maagahi har ras deejai ||6||
lines.translation: the humble servants of my Lord and Master would not even want it. They beg for the Lord to bless them with the Lord's Sublime Essence. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਸਦ ਭੂਖੇ ਨਿਤ ਭੂਖਨ ਭੂਖ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: saakat nar praanee sad bhookhe nit bhookhan bhookh kareejai ||
lines.translation: The faithless cynics and mortal beings remain hungry forever; they continually cry out in hunger.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਾਵਤੁ ਧਾਇ ਧਾਵਹਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਖ ਕੋਸਨ ਕਉ ਬਿਥਿ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: dhaavat dhaai dhaavahi preet maaiaa lakh kosan kau bith deejai ||7||
lines.translation: They hurry and run, and wander all around, caught in the love of Maya; they cover hundreds of thousands of miles in their wanderings. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਊਤਮ ਕਿਆ ਉਪਮਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਦੀਜੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har har har har jan ootam kiaa upamaa tinh deejai ||
lines.translation: The humble servants of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har, are sublime and exalted. What praise can we bestow upon them?
